Example Social closes in a week, on 2027-03-31 15:00 (UTC). Export your data before you lose access to it.

You can sign in and export your data until 2027-04-30 15:00 (UTC). After that, the administrators delete the server's data.

Before the closing date, you can also move your account to another server in the account settings, so that your followers follow you there.

Message from the administrators: Thank you for being here. Please take your posts with you.
